entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It seems this door cannot be opened...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: We'll have to find another way...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I do not intend on dragging your team[n]down. I will gladly prove that intent to[n]you here.
entries.uk: Я не маю наміру тягнути вашу команду[n]донизу. І охоче доведу це[n]тут.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Then I shall exceed your expectations!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Okay, let us commence when you feel[n]ready.

entries.speaker: Mechanical Voice
entries.en: We are currently postponing operation.[n]Please hold.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It doesn't look like this[n]door is going to open...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We should focus on chasing after Sae-san[n]for now!
entries.uk: Поки що зосередьмося на тому,[n]щоб наздогнати пані Сае!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no point in floundering. Let's get[n]down there and hear what she has to say.
entries.uk: Нема сенсу метушитися. Спустімося[n]й послухаймо, що вона скаже.
